template.name: CreateTemplate
template.description: 새로운 쿼리 템플릿을 생성하는 뮤테이션 템플릿
template.query: mutation CreateTemplate($identifier: String!, $name: String!, $description: String, $query: String!) { createTemplate(input: { identifier: $identifier, name: $name, description: $description, query: $query }) { success template { id identifier name description query createdAt isActive } errors { message } } }
